messages:
sre-bot: INCIDENT ➜ observed spike in 5xx on /v1/generate (canary cluster: canary-3). Paging @kai-oncall. Preliminary symptom: increased latency + tokenization errors reported by client telemetry.

kai-oncall: on it, joining now. any recent deploys?

alex-m: yep, small hotpatch rolled ~7m ago: PR 4321 (https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4321). Single commit: 7c9f2a3. It touched tokenizer normalizer (unicode edge cases) and rate-limiter path.

maya-p: saw increased 5xx from canary grafana — baseline 0.4% -> 3.7% in last 5m, latency p95 up ~180ms. errors look like `TokenizerError: unexpected EOF in combined-seq` in logs.

engops: canary only right now (canary-3). Traffic split 5%. We can flip traffic off quickly if needed.

kai-oncall: alex, can you confirm whether this commit changed any native libs / binary deps?

alex-m: no native libs, pure python refactor + small changes to tokenizer regex and the throttling check. I kicked off a quick revert candidate: `git revert 7c9f2a3 -m "revert hotpatch 7c9f2a3"` locally to validate.

pm-bot (support-bot): customer reports coming in: marketplace-beta and integrator-acme showing increased error rates — support routing created INC-2129.

pm-bot (support-bot): NOTE: SLA alert threshold crossed for marketplace-beta (error budget burn).

maya-p: logs from canary pods:
```
[2026-11-02T18:03:21Z] inference-node-7c9f2a3 - TokenizerError: unexpected EOF in combined-seq at tokenizer.py:142
[2026-11-02T18:03:22Z] 5xx count +120 over 5m window
```

engops: suggest kill-route for canary immediately while we validate revert. canary traffic toggle command: `./infra/canary-toggle --cluster canary-3 --set 0%`

kai-oncall: doing kill now.

engops: `OK — canary-3 set to 0%` (deployment bot). Latency + 5xx dropping in the aggregator.

alex-m: I'll prepare the revert PR and push. plan: revert commit, run CI, and patch canary again behind feature flag to test. If fast CI green we can roll to prod rollback.

maya-p: if we can avoid a full rollback to prod, prefer binary decrement of canary and feature-flag off. But since this was a tiny single commit, a revert is cleaner.

alex-m: created PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4323 — revert 7c9f2a3. CI started.

kai-oncall: customers — support-bot, any ETA to impacted customers?

support-bot: CS posted to affected accounts with timeframe: "we are investigating degraded API responses; mitigation in progress; next update in 20m."

engops: CI green on revert PR. I'll coordinate rollout. Rollout plan: apply revert on canary, monitor 10m, then ramp to 30% for 5m, then full traffic if stable.

alex-m: commands I ran for rollback testing (for audit):
```
git checkout -b revert-hotpatch-7c9f2a3
git revert --no-edit 7c9f2a3
git push origin revert-hotpatch-7c9f2a3
# PR created and merged: revert PR 4323
```

engops: kicking deployment: `kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/inference-service-canary-3`

deployment-bot: rollout started for inference-service-canary-3 (rev: revert-7c9f2a3).

maya-p: canary pods back up. early logs: no TokenizerError in last 30s window. 5xx is down to 0.6%. good sign.

kai-oncall: good. let's hold at canary for 15m. if stable, we'll roll to prod with a slow ramp and keep feature-flag ready to kill.

alex-m: creating canary feature-flag `tokenizer_v2_enabled` and defaulting to off for prod traffic until we validate.

engops: prod ramp started to 10%. monitoring: infra traces + client telemetry.

maya-p: 10% prod stable for 5m, p95 back to baseline, no tokenizer errors.

kai-oncall: continue ramp to 50% then 100% with 5m waits. keep support/pm updated.

pm-bot (support-bot): updated customers: brief note that mitigation deployed, monitoring shows recovery, will follow up when fully resolved.

engops: rolled to 50% -> stable. rolled to 100% -> stable. feature-flag remains available to flip off instantly if we see regressions.

kai-oncall: summarizing for handoff:
- root cause: single commit 7c9f2a3 introduced tokenizer edge-case causing TokenizerError and 5xx spike on canary.
- mitigation: cut canary traffic, reverted commit (PR 4323), validated canary, gradual prod ramp, feature-flag added as insurance.
- impact: short-lived canary-induced 5xx spike; affected customers (marketplace-beta, integrator-acme) saw transient errors; no data loss. SLA burn minimal, CS notified.
- actions: postmortem owner: alex-m, timeline capture + tests to add for tokenizer normalization edgecases, add canary/rollback runbook note.

kai-oncall: handing off to next oncall @maya-p at 1896543600. watchlist: watch downstream client retries and any residual error reports for next 2 hours.

maya-p: ack. I'll monitor dashboards and follow up with alex-m on test coverage. thanks team :thumbsup:

sre-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — status: mitigated. Follow-up: postmortem required within 48h (owner: alex-m).
